`_run_batch` (frame code via `_on_frame`) goes over every slot of `_watches` three times per round (:649, :655, :658). It does so even when only a few watches are pending, so the cost of one frame with a pending evaluation grows with the total number of watches, not the pending ones. `_on_user_state_changed`, `_on_named_trigger` and `_on_content_event` (:685, :698, :708) likewise go over every slot per event.
